notes.title: HAAK | Update Notice for Version V1.4.0.18027M︱December 1st
notes.notes:
Attention HAAKers, "HAAK" has been updated to the new version V1.4.0.18027M. This update mainly focuses on enhancing the gaming experience and fixing several known issues.

Here's a detailed list of the updates:

1. Fixed an issue where achievements were not displaying correctly in certain cases.
2. Resolved the issue of garbled text in the production list at the end.
3. Fixed the problem that the key change settings did not take effect in some cases.
4. Solved the issue where the exploration percentage did not exceed 100% after exploring the “Black and White” DLC.
5. Fixed the problem of not being able to access the DLC after being hostile to Yaam.
6. Added first aid kits in the Peak of Faith area.
7. To alleviate potential frame rate issues, unnecessary venomous have been removed from the Peak of Faith.
8. Resolved a crash issue that could occur after completing the Dash room.

notes.title: 《HAAK》V1.0.1 Minor update Annoucement - Sep. 2022
notes.notes:
It's been a week since the release of HAAK 1.0, great to see a lot of new players joining our community. Thanks again for supporting HAAK! 

We've made some tweaks in response to various valuable feedback received during this week. You're welcome to provide more feedback! 

Content Changes 
- Genie now founded Genie Studio in the Sanho Ruins 
- Added a new item: Image#15(Genie life photo) 
- Item Misc#27(Laxative) is now directly accessible inside the levels, there is no need to go through some specific sidequest just for that item anymore 
- Life Shard and Attack Upgrade acquired from Genie are also directly accessible inside the levels now, no need to commit suicide just to get them 
- difficulty of parts of the platforming has been reduced 

Optimizations 
- Puzzle optimizations in [Anthony Hill] 
- NPC location guidance optimization in [Anthony Hill] 
- Added some more "Big Oafs" to [Peoples' Square] 
- Enhanced visual distinction of some interactable elements 
Fixes 
- Fixed some item images 
- Fixed a bug where some items cannot be acquired through up thrusting 
- Fixed several bugs in [Subway Tunnel] etc where the player might not be able to proceed after being squeezed to death 
- Fixed several bugs in [Merlin Pit], [Anthony Hill], [Momoyama Castle] etc where the player might not be able to proceed after force quitting the game after some cutscenes 
- Fixed an animation issue in [Anthony Hill] 
- Fixed several bugs related to locked area fights 
- Fixed a bug that might make [Peoples' Square] not accessible through the world map 
- Fixed English and Russian translation issues related to the password to Fatty's terminal 
- Other minor fixes 

Update Plans 
We'll continue updating HAAK in the following period, our plan includes but is not limited to the following points, please stay tuned! 
- A new mysterious NPC 
- New collectible items 
- Expansion to Yaam's storyline 
- Optimizations related to location guidance, boss fight mechanism guidance... etc

notes.title: Major Update V0.9
notes.notes:
HAAKers Sorry for the long wait! Beta branch(beta_ea) 0.9 is now available! EA public will also be updated simultaneously, except for the level part(The robot will still block your in White Stone, you can join the beta branch to continue the game).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/4aa4022de66a28f3f2e9134337540c014936de15.png

Levels and enemies
- 5 new levels have been added, thus meaning that all levels of HAAK are available now！
- Almost all existing levels have undergone a new round of optimization
- 4 new monsters and 1 new boss
- Some enemies have been visually improved
- The gameplay flow of Sanho Ruins has been reworked, now you can get weapon and start fighting earlier

Warning: Because the level structure of Sanho Ruins has changed dramatically, the entire progress of Sanho Ruins will be RESET, but technically will not affect the rest of the game (you can still play through the game normally), if you are very concerned about this, please restart a new game, we are very sorry for the inconvenience caused to you during the Early Access.

Storyline
- Several new NPCs have been added, some of them do not have dialogues yet (will be updated next) and you cannot interact with them, please don't be surprised
- More than 10 side quests are now fully available, some of them contain branches
- A new dream sequence, completing HAAK's backstory
- Two game endings

mechanics:
- No more physical instant death, players will teleport to the nearest respawn point after being physically crushed
- Added 3 new skills, including hacking
- Added 1 new basic move: downward slash
- Interaction adjustment: the default button is modified to "B" on the xbox controller, HAAK can interact when moving, removed the button press time
- Greenie coin system improvement
- More than 10 new Steam achievements
- New end-of-game evaluation system

Problem fixes
- Many problems fixed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/5fb98abbf63a41d20f8930fc7ebb06b1e1d25734.png

notes.title: The last round of PlayTest before version 1.0 is now OPEN!
notes.notes:
Dear HAAKers, as we previously teased, our game is almost done!

In order to ensure the final quality of HAAK, we will open a 14-day-long final test from March 28th, you can experience the first 2~3 hours of the content. We warmly welcome all players to participate!

How to sign up: Under the [Join the HAAK Playtest] section on the game store page, click the green button [Request Access], we will send system emails periodically to invite players to join the test.

Test date: March 28th to April 10th

Feedback channel: 
1. Welcome to leave a message on the Steam discussion board
2. Join our official Discord to communicate with our producer face to face: https://discord.gg/7AwDTs42
3. Click the following link:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1ejCmbvkj3W0dRl6TFZ8DXau9273eefYxhnABel9TKJw/edit?usp=sharing

Please start the adventure with HAAK!

notes.title: Small Update - Optimized movement and combat game feel
notes.notes:
Small Update - Optimized movement and combat game feel

Level
-Added an exclusive 'Greenie Coins' vending machine to Merlin Pit, which can reduce the difficulty of the corresponding escape sequence and Boss battles

Skills mechanism adjustment
-Optimized edge sliding: When performing dash, diving thrust, jumping, thrust up and other actions, the actions will be less jammed by the edge of the platform. Example: It will be easier to dash into a low channel; standing close to the edge of the platform and perform a diving thrust, the character will drop with more ease.

-New mechanism [Falling acceleration]: Keep pressing "down" when dropping in the air will speed up the falling speed

-Increased the lift height of Slash Upwards by 1.25 times

-Haak will become invincible during the first frame of a charged attack, and it will be easier to deflect missiles

-More tolerant climbing judgment: You can grab the hanging point from bottom to top, and it can also "snap" up within a certain pixel range.

-Now you can dash while climbing

-Dash can now cancel the recovery time of landing

-Thrust Up can now cancel charged attack backswing 

-Thrust Up, Dash, Jump can now cancel climbing

Action time adjustment
-Shortened the maximum recovery time for after landing to 0.5 seconds

-Shortened the time required for climbing and hanging

-Shortened wind-up time and backswing time when launching hooks

-Shortened the wind-up time of the charged attack

-Dash adjustment: Shortened the overall dash time and shortened the interval between double dash; the second dash can be launched sooner now.

-Reduce the wind-up time of Upwards Slash to be the same as the horizontal attack

Attack judgment adjustment
-Expanded the damage range after Diving Thrust, it is now easier to stun against the shielded mob

-Expanded the hitbox for stunning when using charged attacks against clawman.

notes.title: 【Playtest Branch Update】'Merlin Pit' now available for Playtest!
notes.notes:
Hey HAAKers!

Today we will be pushing an update including the latest Chapter 6 'Merlin Pit' onto our Beta Test Branch! Playtesters! We look forward to your thoughts and feedback!

If you haven't already, and would like to become one of our Playtesters and try out Chapter 6 now, please join our Discord Channel, and we will send you the code for the Beta Test branch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/1bea87d9b69694e9d1deeef4cb0241402271f6b7.png

This patch includes the below content:

Levels
- Chapter 6 'Merlin Pit' is now available to play! Explore brand new maps [Sillie Farm](Partly Unlocked) and [Anthony Hill](Partly Unlocked), with new stories, enemies and new skills!
- New skills will open up more backtracking rooms, time to check them out!
- Adjusted the difficulty for the 'Fatty' Boss Battle in [People's Square]


Enemies
- Added Clawman, Snail, Hotpot, Dirt Eater and Rocket robot...


Skills, controls and Interactions
- Charged Attack: You can now move during charged attacks
- General Attack: You can now perform a general attack with infinite combos 
- Diving Thrust: Hold [Arrow Down Key] when performing Diving Thrust, HAAK will not land on one-way platforms during the drop.


Others
- Introducing the new 'Rookie's Coin' system: A service that can be used to adjust the game's difficulty, every time HAAK when dies, the player will be automatically given a Rookie's Coin, use the coins gained in the vending machine to purchase different buffs, which will help you while exploring the world of HAAK with more ease, preventing players to stuck in more difficult levels such as the 'Fatty' Boss Fight.

However as this is still a new system, so currently only the most basic items(buffs) can be purchased, we will be adding in more items in the future. Once again, this system is for players who would like a much easier game experience, the difficulty of the game will be reduced massively(including IMBA), so for players who prefer a much challenging game experience, please skip this service, as using too many Rookie's Coins will affect your final game result and achievement. 

Fixes
- Fixed the bug which might cause abnormal animations during recovery, while HAAK is performing and aim.
- Fixed the bug which could cause the player to fall when hanging with the hook, while calling up the game menu.
- Fixed a bug in [Subway Tunnel] where players might not be able to call up the game menu when the self-destruction system finishes reading the progress for the first time.
- Improved the rendering system's stability


If you encounter other problems, don't forget to contact us via Steam community or Twitter/Discord. 


We look forward to having you as our playtester, Happy gaming! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch Note #2：Data reading issues, Boss fight and Feedback prompt
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We want to thank you all for the support and valuable feedback!

Today we released a patch 7207EA, with the follow bugs fixed:
- Fixed data reading issues when creating a new game when there are multiple games saved
- Fixed the loading issue when respawning back in Sanhe Ruins
- Fixed the issue where the power engine in the North Station couldn’t reset after player respawn, if progress not saved
- Fixed the possible lagging and gravity issues during boss battle with Wang Ping
- Added feedback prompt on the HUD, which can be disabled in Settings
- Added feedback report servers to solve the problem with the progress updates in feedback.

And some advices for you: 
1. For players using Nvidia 27.21.14.5148, or players experiencing unexpected game shut-down, please try updating the Graphics Card Driver to the latest version 27.21.14.5206(452.06)
2. Some controller issues may be caused by abnormal connections. Please try to unplug the controller and reconnect it. If it still can't work, please send a feedback report.
3. For players who met with data reading issues (most of you may be unable to leave the scene after returning to the Sanhe Ruins back), you can upload the error log through the BUG feedback system and leave your contact information, if you don't mind, so we can repair the data and resend it to you. (Of course, this is a very rare situation)

Happy Gaming and good luck with your adventure!
